title: Detailed book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='coverGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e63946'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b3202c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pageGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff8e7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0e0b8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='spineGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c62a36'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#931d27'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow under book -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='36' ry='5' fill='#3a2f4a' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- back cover -->
  <path d='M18 20 L64 16 Q66 16 66 18 L66 78 Q66 80 64 80 L18 84 Q16 84 16 82 L16 22 Q16 20 18 20 Z' fill='#8f1a24'/>
  <!-- pages (stack) -->
  <path d='M21 22 L64 18 L64 78 L21 82 Z' fill='#e8d6a8'/>
  <path d='M23 22.3 L64 18.6 L64 19.8 L23 23.6 Z' fill='#d9c48f'/>
  <path d='M23 78.8 L64 75.2 L64 76.5 L23 80 Z' fill='#d9c48f'/>
  <!-- front cover -->
  <path d='M18 20 L63 16 Q65 16 65 18 L65 78 Q65 80 63 80 L18 84 Q16 84 16 82 L16 22 Q16 20 18 20 Z' fill='url(#coverGrad)'/>
  <!-- spine -->
  <path d='M16 22 L20 20.7 L20 81.3 L16 82 Z' fill='url(#spineGrad)'/>
  <path d='M16 22 L18 21.2 L18 80.8 L16 82 Z' fill='#a8222e' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- spine bands -->
  <rect x='16' y='30' width='4.4' height='2.6' fill='#f4c95d' transform='skewY(-5)'/>
  <rect x='16' y='68' width='4.4' height='2.6' fill='#f4c95d' transform='skewY(-5)'/>
  <!-- cover border -->
  <path d='M21 23.5 L60 19.8 L60 76.3 L21 80 Z' fill='none' stroke='#f4c95d' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <!-- cover ornament: circle + star -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='9.5' fill='#f4c95d' opacity='0.95'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='7' fill='#b3202c'/>
  <path d='M40 27.5 L42.1 32 L47 32.4 L43.3 35.6 L44.6 40.3 L40 37.5 L35.4 40.3 L36.7 35.6 L33 32.4 L37.9 32 Z' fill='#f4c95d'/>
  <!-- cover title bars -->
  <rect x='27' y='48' width='26' height='2.4' fill='#f4c95d' opacity='0.9' transform='skewY(-5)'/>
  <rect x='27' y='53' width='20' height='2.4' fill='#f4c95d' opacity='0.9' transform='skewY(-5)'/>
  <rect x='27' y='58' width='23' height='2.4' fill='#f4c95d' opacity='0.7' transform='skewY(-5)'/>
  <!-- ribbon bookmark -->
  <path d='M52 79 L55 79 L55 92 L53.5 89 L52 92 Z' fill='#4cc9f0'/>
  <path d='M52 79 L53.5 79 L53.5 90.2 L52 92 Z' fill='#2f9fc4' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- page edges detail -->
  <path d='M63 17 L63 79' stroke='#c9b070' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
